title: cAMP Regulated Cl- Current Protocol
author: Robert Harvey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba8pihvn

steps.title: Prepare extracellular solution
steps.instruction: Make a K⁺‑free extracellular solution containing (in mM): NaCl 140, CsCl 5.4, CaCl₂ 2.5, MgCl₂ 0.5, glucose 5.5, HEPES 5 (adjust to pH 7.4). Keep the solution at room temperature and add nisoldipine to a final concentration of 1 µM to block L‑type Ca²⁺ channels.

steps.title: Prepare intracellular pipette solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a K⁺‑free microelectrode (pipette) solution containing (in mM): Cs‑glutamate 130, TEA‑Cl 20, EGTA 5, MgATP 5, TrisGTP 0.06, HEPES 5 (adjust to pH 7.2).

steps.title: Set up perfusion chamber and microscope
steps.instruction: Mount a Warner Instruments perfusion chamber on the stage of an inverted Olympus IX71 microscope, ensuring proper connections for solution exchange.

steps.title: Place cells and perfuse with solution
steps.instruction: Introduce isolated pig ventricular myocytes into the chamber and continuously perfuse with the prepared extracellular solution (containing nisoldipine).

steps.title: Pull and test patch electrodes
steps.instruction: Pull glass microelectrodes and select those with resistances between 1 and 2 MΩ before use.

steps.title: Form whole‑cell configuration and compensate resistance
steps.instruction: Establish a whole‑cell patch on a cell, then compensate the access resistance so that series‑resistance errors are less than 5 mV.

steps.title: Configure recording hardware and software
steps.instruction: Connect the cell to a Multiclamp 700B amplifier and a Digidata 1440A interface, launch pClamp 11 software, set low‑pass filter to 4 kHz and sampling rate to 10 kHz.

steps.title: Set voltage protocol and acquire baseline
steps.instruction: Hold the membrane potential at –30 mV. Apply a 100 ms test pulse to +50 mV every 5 s to measure the cAMP‑regulated Cl⁻ current. Record until a stable baseline is reached (approximately 5 min).

steps.title: Apply test drugs and continue recording
steps.instruction: Introduce the desired test‑drug(s) into the perfusion bath and continue the same voltage‑pulse protocol while recording.

steps.title: Calculate cAMP‑induced Cl‑ current
steps.instruction: Determine the cAMP‑regulated Cl⁻ current by subtracting the current amplitude recorded before drug application from the amplitude recorded after drug application, using the values measured during each test pulse.
